records.publisher: Open Government Data Platform India / Directorate of Marketing and Inspection (AGMARKNET)
records.title: Current Daily Price of Various Commodities from Various Markets (Mandi)
records.licence: unstated on retrieved artifacts; portal states GODL-India but licence page returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch (not verified verbatim)
records.availabilityPolicy: Daily; title says 'Current' - history depth NOT verified. Resource UUID taken from portal backend metadata for catalog nid 86944 (data/raw/datagovin/catalog_86944_resources.json).
records.notes: Keyless request returns HTTP 400 {"error": "Authorization field missing"}. Catalog metadata embeds a portal-published sample key in datafile_url; use of that key was denied by the session permission policy and was not attempted. Registration for a personal free key was not performed (out of scope). Field names, units (INR/quintal is typical but unverified here) and ginger rows NOT observed.

records.publisher: Open Government Data Platform India / DMI
records.title: Variety-wise Daily Market Prices Data of Commodity
records.licence: unstated on retrieved artifacts; portal states GODL-India but licence page returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch (not verified verbatim)
records.availabilityPolicy: Catalog metadata: created 2024-05-21, data_time_period_from=to=2024-05-21, changed 2026-10-28. Whether the API holds accumulated history since 2024-05-21 is NOT verified.
records.notes: Same key gate as 9ef84268. Most promising candidate for >1 season of history; must be measured once a key is available. sha256/retrievedAt refer to the metadata listing, not to price rows.

records.publisher: Open Government Data Platform India / Govt of Tamil Nadu
records.title: Production of Ginger by Districts in Tamil Nadu 2018-19 (one of 15 TN ginger APY resources 2011-12..2018-19)
records.licence: unstated on retrieved artifacts; portal states GODL-India but licence page returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch (not verified verbatim)
records.availabilityPolicy: Static yearly files per catalog search (data/raw/datagovin/search_ginger.json)
records.notes: HTTP 403 to scripted GET. Tamil Nadu is a minor ginger state; low priority.

records.publisher: Directorate of Marketing and Inspection, MoA&FW
records.title: Agmarknet 2.0 (React single-page app; legacy SearchCmmMkt.aspx now serves the same shell)
records.availabilityPolicy: Report queries go to https://api.agmarknet.gov.in/v1/ ; the shipped JS attaches captcha/captcha_key to report requests (/captcha/generator, /captcha/verify; '/prices-and-a...' report calls).
records.notes: CAPTCHA-gated interactive reports. Internal API not called; no CAPTCHA bypass. Manual human export by the user may be possible but its terms were not verified.

records.publisher: Centre for Economic Data and Analysis, Ashoka University (third party; source DMI)
records.title: CEDA Agmarknet portal
records.availabilityPolicy: Page shows 'Download Data' buttons; login/terms not stated on the page.
records.notes: HTTP 200 to page request only. Third-party aggregation (district/monthly); not market-level primary data. Terms must be checked before any use.

records.title: Ginger prices Karnataka (web search snippets only)
records.notes: Only used as weak evidence that Karnataka APMCs (Hassan, Belur, Holenarasipura, Mysore-Bandipalya, Bangalore, Ramanagara, Doddaballapur, Somvarpet, Chikkamagaluru) have reported ginger in 2026; levels inconsistent (INR 2,000 vs 10,000/quintal within one district) -> product/grade identity problem. Not a data source for the product.

records.publisher: Directorate of Economics and Statistics, MoA&FW
records.title: Crops APY report
records.notes: HTML form page retrieved (curl; Python requests fails: server sends incomplete certificate chain). Data via jQuery POST with session CSRF _token returning an HTML table; 'Excel' is client-side conversion. No documented export/API; no CAPTCHA seen. No APY rows retrieved.

records.publisher: Directorate of Economics and Statistics, MoA&FW
records.title: APY query report
records.notes: As above: form fields fltrstates[], fltrdistricts, crop, season, year range, report format scrview|exl; session token required. Manual export by a user is the lawful route; not automated.

records.title: UPAg national crop calendar
records.notes: 7 KB JS-only shell ('You need to enable JavaScript'); no calendar data in HTML. Content not inspected.

records.title: UPAg API Data Share OpenAPI 1.0.0
records.availabilityPolicy: All data endpoints require OAuth2PasswordBearer (tokenUrl v1/upag/api-data-share/login). Credential issuance process unknown.
records.notes: Spec retrieved (9 operations). No crop-calendar endpoint in the spec. Treated as blocked: credentials not available and not requested.

records.title: District agriculture contingency plans index
records.notes: 648 PDF links on index. Karnataka: 29 links incl. Hassan, Shimoga, Kodagu, Mysore, Chikmagalur. Kerala plans dated 30-06-2011.

records.title: Agriculture contingency plan: Hassan (KA28), 04.10.2011
records.availabilityPolicy: Static PDF; plan date 2011 - currency must be reviewed
records.notes: pypdf: 40/42 pages with text. Ginger appears in the horticulture spices table ('Ginger 13.8' under 'Total Area'; table header reads Area (`000 ha) -> 13.8 thousand ha; plausibility vs state totals is questionable (column alignment from pdftotext -layout); verify manually before use).

records.title: Ginger resources page
Ginger (extension pamphlet, February 2025; Thankamani et al.)
records.notes: pypdf: 28/32 pages with text, 42,193 chars; pdftotext also works. States 2022-23 national production 22.01 lakh t from 190,000 ha; MP, Karnataka, Orissa, Assam, Meghalaya, Arunachal, Gujarat = 65%. Do not redistribute (licence unstated).

records.title: Major spice / state-wise area and production of spices 2021-22..2025-26*

products: ginger (form not stated in extracted text)

records.notes: Area ha, production tonnes. Ginger block (row-order inferred, needs manual check): 2024-25f MP 38,023 ha / 624,138 t; Karnataka 33,756 ha / 379,151 t; Odisha 20,925 ha / 269,513 t. Production basis (fresh vs dry) not stated in extracted text.

records.title: Historical Weather API (ERA5/ERA5-Land/IFS)
records.licence: CC BY 4.0 ('The data obtained through the API is provided under the terms of the CC-BY 4.0 licence'); free tier non-commercial only
records.availabilityPolicy: ERA5 daily update with 5-day delay; reanalysis is not a forecast available at the time
records.notes: Sample 2026-09-01..30 daily, 30/30 non-null, rain 74.0 mm. Free tier: <10,000 calls/day, 5,000/h, 600/min; commercial use requires subscription.

records.title: Forecast API
records.notes: 16 days returned, day 16 null (15/16 non-null).

records.title: Historical Forecast API
records.availabilityPolicy: Stitched series of each run's first hours - NOT an archive of what was forecast weeks ahead; unsuitable as a planting-time multi-week forecast

records.title: Previous Runs API
records.notes: Leakage-free forecasts at <=7 day lead can be reconstructed from 2024; nothing for seasonal (harvest-horizon) lead.

records.title: Agromet advisory national (past)
records.notes: Advisory bulletins (PDF), not a gridded/station series API. No machine-readable district forecast endpoint identified.

records.title: GKMS standard operating procedure
records.notes: District/block quantitative forecast up to 5 days; advisories issued Tuesday and Friday; ERFS extended range exists.
